title: cissampelos pareira var. senensis
intro: Cissampelos pareira var. senensis, commonly known as the "Kulattha" or "Talimkhuta", is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia, belonging to the family Menispermaceae. This plant is known for its traditional medicinal uses and health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, as well as its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cissampelos pareira var. senensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and other secondary metabolites, such as pareirine and senegin. These constituents contribute to the plant's therapeutic effects, including its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity.
